name: near_52w_high_252d
description: Close divided by its trailing 252-trading-day high (current bar included): how close the price is to its 52-week high-water mark. Requires the full 252-bar window and at least 200 valid closes inside it; direction +1.
mechanism: 52-week high anchoring: proximity to the high-water mark proxies persistent positive momentum / underreaction to good news.
formula: NHP_t = close_t / max(close_{t-251..t}) over finite closes > 0; NaN unless the full 252-bar window exists and >= 200 valid closes are in the window; output in (0, 1]
